subject.title: fix(backup): sweep stale temp artifacts before creating new backup

question: Should backup startup automatically delete OpenClaw-owned stale staging directories and archive temp files after the grace window once the matcher covers timestamped and retry temp paths?
rationale: The code defect is mechanical, but the destructive startup cleanup policy can affect operator recovery/debugging expectations and overlapping backup safety, so maintainer intent is needed before merge.

options.title: Accept guarded startup cleanup after repair
options.body: Require the timestamped/retry-path repair, focused tests, and real proof, then accept the one-hour owner-guarded deletion policy for OpenClaw-owned backup temps.

options.title: Limit cleanup to fixed output paths
options.body: Accept a narrower cleanup that only removes stable-basename archive temps and keep default timestamped cleanup for a follow-up or external janitor.

options.title: Pause for a different recovery policy
options.body: Pause or close this PR if stale backup temps should remain inspectable until a doctor command, explicit cleanup command, or operator-owned policy exists.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded startup cleanup after repair
recommendation.body: Require the timestamped/retry-path repair, focused tests, and real proof, then accept the one-hour owner-guarded deletion policy for OpenClaw-owned backup temps.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle merged the original backup CLI and carried backup hardening/refactor history around the affected surface.
